narration: Two inputs: the image I, and a text prompt listing candidate categories.
Each passes through its own frozen CLIP encoder, visual and language.
CLIP gives a visual feature map F-v and a text embedding F-l.
V-L Correlation matches every visual location against the text embedding.
That yields the correlation volume C-v-and-l, which enters the ESC-Block.
Inside, PPG converts the correlation into pseudo prompts: point clicks and candidate masks.
The SAM Block refines the visual features using those prompts, producing F-v-prime.
The VLF Block fuses them with the text embedding and the earlier correlation.
Out comes a sharpened correlation volume; the ESC-Block repeats N times.
The Decoder turns the final correlation volume into the predicted mask M.
